name: Sightlines
definition: The line from an eye position, such as an entrance or a seat, to a target. A clear sightline joins the viewer to the focal point.

sources.title: Julius Panero and Martin Zelnik, Human Dimension and Interior Space (Whitney Library of Design, 1979)
Francis D. K. Ching, Architecture: Form, Space, and Order (Wiley, 4th edition, 2014)
